elements.text:
Your family members have some strong opinions and you don't always agree with them. One evening, you invite a friend over for dinner. 

Here are some thoughts that might pop into mind:

texts: My friend will be my friend no matter what my parents think.
My parents will say something that makes my friend hate me.
I think I am smart for thinking on my own.
Even if my parents say something that's upsetting, my friend and I can talk about it later.
If my parents say things that I don't agree with, they're still my parents and I love them.
